_note: Token-aligned counterfactual templates for the ladder levels (same placeholders as ladder/L*.txt, vehicle class only: the CDIM maps run on the drive scenarios; the walk scenarios enter as the control question under the drive scenario's substrate, as cdim.py does with the library question). Each entry replaces one bullet line of the level with a line of the same token count under the Llama-3 and Qwen3 tokenizers that reverses its semantics. build_prompts.py fills them per scenario; check_align.py verifies the counts; cdim.py skips any line that is not aligned. L0 uses ../cdim_counterfactuals.json.

L1.name: cf1
L1.text: - Perform an activity on an object, without transporting the object from location A to B.

L1.name: cf2
L1.text: - All other objectives or goals are relevant for the user.

L1.name: cf3
L1.text: - Activities require the object to stay at location A while the user moves to location B, whether the user walks or drives.

L1.name: cf4
L1.text: - The object is never initially with the user at location A.

L1.name: cf5
L1.text: - Moving the user without moving the object, as when the user walks away from it, does fully satisfy the objective.

L1.name: cf6
L1.text: - If the object is a vehicle, the user may leave it, that is walk off, in order to perform the activity at location B.

L1.name: cf6s
L1.text: - If the object is a vehicle, the user must leave it, that is walk off, in order to perform the activity at location B.

L2.name: cf1
